_doc: Uniform rule on a synthetic flat sheet (src/metrics/calibrate_attributes.py; never tuned on specimens): threshold_k = midpoint between operator k's own response and the largest response of any OTHER operator on detector k. If the own response does not exceed every off-target response the detector is NON-SPECIFIC and is excluded from binary recall/unsupported-rate (raw score still reported). Pucker uses blister DENSITY (distinct blisters per (0.1 L)^2 of sheet area); the absolute count used first was not scale-invariant (deviation logged in reports/03).
